What we do

One supplier for the whole kitchen.

  • Food distribution

    Over 2,000 products: local and imported deli meats, cheeses and the kitchen essentials you reorder every week.

  • Custom sourcing

    Looking for something specific? We work with our suppliers to bring in specialty items for your menu.

  • Food safety & compliance

    CFIA import licence, recall programs and arrival controls on every product we receive.

  • Logistics & warehousing

    Storage and delivery planned around your service, including recurring orders.

Our story

Three generations. It started with pepperoni.

  1. 1954

    Giuseppe “Joe” and Raymond “Ray” Teolis start delivering fresh pepperoni to neighbourhood pizzerias.

  2. Growing

    As our customers’ kitchens grew, so did the selection: deli meats, imported cheeses, Italian specialties.

  3. Today

    The third generation carries on in Saint-Léonard, with the same care for the products and the people who serve them.

Partnering with brands our clients trust.

FAQ

Questions, answered.

Something else? Talk to a person.

514.729.6470
What areas do you serve?

We distribute throughout Quebec and surrounding areas.

How do I become a customer?

Fill out the contact form below or call us at 514.729.6470. We’ll set up your account and pricing.

What is your minimum order?

$500 for local deliveries.

What are your delivery times?

It depends on your location, but we aim for 1–2 business days.

Can I set up recurring orders?

Yes. We offer recurring deliveries on the schedule that suits your kitchen.

Can I place a custom order?

Yes. We work with our suppliers to source specialty products for your business.

What products do you specialize in?

Deli meats, cheeses and imported specialty foods, mostly Italian.

Do you carry sanitation and paper products?

Yes, a wide range of cleaning, packaging and paper products for food businesses.

Do you offer food safety programs?

Yes. We hold a CFIA import licence and run food safety and product recall programs.

Are your products locally sourced?

We carry a mix of local and imported products to fit your needs.
